Game Overview

At its heart, Mecha Son of Mecha is a action game about defend your base in Mecha Son of Mecha by mastering exhilarating battles as a powerful robotic defender. Strategically switch between piloting the mech and gathering resources on foot. Maintain your machine's power, tactically use weapons, and employ clever strategies to overcome relentless enemy waves in this action-packed adventure.
